rejected_structural_assertions: Aggregate invoice does not bill the order line
Credit memo is not linked to the original invoice
Customer location belongs to another customer
Partial shipment lacks the expected committed stock movement
Retry produced a duplicate business key
Reversal does not cancel each accounting account
Shipment does not fulfill the order line
The failed firstOnly locking API cannot inherit the collection-query result
requirements: One customer, one customer location, one sold and stocked product, one product-price record.
One opening-inventory line and one order line for that product.
Two shipment headers, each with exactly one line linked to the same order line.
One sales invoice with exactly one aggregate order-linked line; example: two shipments -> one aggregate invoice line. Two shipment-linked invoice lines are rejected.
One payment settles the invoice; allocation headers are completed and all related accounting is posted and balanced.
One credit invoice refers to the original invoice, has one line, and has one reciprocal reversal with one line. Both end reversed; accounting cancels by account.
Rollback the first draft explicitly before retry. Repeating the same caller key returns the one existing record.

Two separate transactions update the same customer with Query.setForUpdate(true).list and one selected primary key. Hold the first lock while the second blocks. Include a 1.5 second observation window before releasing the lock and before rolling back the draft.
Commit completed documents through native application workflows; use typed Posted access and do not explicitly repost a posted document.
selector_semantics: Each only(table, conditions) requires exactly one matching committed row; stages declared in the base public contract must each identify exactly one row.
